primary_title: IRE1alpha induces thioredoxin-interacting protein to activate the NLRP3 inflammasome and promote programmed cell death during endoplasmic reticulum stress
decision_basis: Primary IRE1alpha forced-activation and loss-of-function assays support IRE1alpha-dependent TXNIP induction through an RNase/miR-17 mRNA-stability mechanism.
limitations_preserved: Preserve terminal-UPR severity, IRE1alpha RNase and miR-17 mechanism; indirect TXNIP induction; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: IRE1alpha induces thioredoxin-interacting protein to activate the NLRP3 inflammasome and promote programmed cell death during endoplasmic reticulum stress
decision_basis: Primary Perk-null and forced PERK kinase-domain activation assays support PERK-dependent TXNIP induction during ER stress.
limitations_preserved: Preserve terminal-UPR severity and PERK/ATF5-ChREBP mechanism; indirect TXNIP induction; no SCI or terminal-TF inference.

primary_title: Thioredoxin-interacting protein links oxidative stress to inflammasome activation
decision_basis: Primary co-immunoprecipitation, genetic deficiency/rescue and cytokine assays support ROS-dependent TXNIP association with and activation of the NLRP3 inflammasome.
limitations_preserved: Preserve ROS/thioredoxin dissociation, inflammasome stimulus and cell-type dependence; no universal NLRP3 ligand or SCI/terminal-TF inference.
